title: Synapse User
description: A Matrix user account on a Synapse homeserver

avatar_url.description: MXC URI for the user's avatar image

is_guest.description: Whether this is a guest account

admin.description: Whether the user has server admin privileges

deactivated.description: Whether the account has been deactivated

erased.description: Whether the user's data has been erased

shadow_banned.description: Whether the user is shadow-banned (can send but others won't receive)

creation_ts.description: Account creation timestamp in seconds since epoch

address.description: The third-party identifier value (email address or phone number)

threepids.description: Third-party identifiers (email addresses, phone numbers) linked to the account

external_id.description: The user's ID in the external provider

user_type.description: User type (null for normal users, 'bot', 'support', etc.)
